video_title: Lakers in Slovenia thru Vando's cam. Bronny, Looney talking about Luka Doncic and Slovenia

quotes.speaker: Bronny James
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James on the team bonding benefits of the Slovenia trip
quotes.excerpt: the Slovenia trip helped because we got back home and we got to work

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: Let's talk about the summer. How's your summer been?

text_blocks.speaker: Bronny James
text_blocks.text: Summer's been great. Taking the time to get away. We had the Slovenia trip. That was great. Everyone's great. We've been in the gym working. There's good vibes everywhere. I think again, the Slovenia trip helped because we got back home and we got to work and it's good for us, and it's going to be good for us getting the season too.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney on Luka Doncic's leadership and character during Slovenia trip
quotes.excerpt: that just shows his character showing that he wants to really want to win

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: What is it like for you though, just Slovenia in particular has become higher profile with Luka being with the Lakers?

text_blocks.speaker: Kevon Looney
text_blocks.text: I've been in the league for a while and that was my first time doing something like that to go into somebody's country and bringing us all out there and spending that much time together. I never did that before. So that just shows his character showing that he wants to really want to win. He wants people to know his background why he is how he is and I think we did a good job of that. He's a great player and a great leader and he likes to show what he can do on the court and we got to see his personality off the court.

quotes.speaker: Gregor Sevsek
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregor Sevsek on Luka Doncic's status as a global sports star
quotes.excerpt: I believe I don't overreact if I say biggest sport star in Slovenia now
quotes.quote: It's a big question when next time here in Slovenia we'll be able to watch these stars. All thanks to Luka. It just shows how big sport star he is. I believe I don't overreact if I say biggest sport star in Slovenia now. This team bonding could take place anywhere else, but this one started here and we can be very proud of it!
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Vprašanje je, kdaj bomo sploh naslednjič lahko takšne zvezde opazovali v Ljubljani oziroma jim ukradli kakšen trenutek. Vse to pa lahko pripišemo Luki in v bistvu kakšna mega zvezda je. Verjetno ne pretiravam, če rečem največja športna zvezda zdaj. To team bonding se bi lahko zgodil kjerkoli drugje, ampak se je to zgodilo ravno pri nas, mislim, da smo lahko zelo ponosni na tole.
